title: Battery Supply-Chain Due-Diligence Record
description: EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 · Chapter VII · Art. 47–53. Mandatory since 18 Aug 2025 for economic operators placing batteries on the EU market that contain cobalt, natural graphite, lithium or nickel above the Annex X thresholds. OECD-aligned management system, identified and mitigated risks, independent verification.

substance.description: Which raw material the due-diligence record covers. Art. 47(1) — only these four substances are in scope.

scope.description: Audit scope — which segment of the supply chain the verifier covered.

oecd_compliant.description: Compliance flag against the OECD Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Supply Chains.

verifier_name.description: Legal name of the third-party verifier. Required.

notified_body_id.description: Optional FK to a notified-body record if the verifier is an EU notified body.

risk_areas_assessed.description: Annex X risk categories assessed by the management system.

cahras_red_flags.description: Conflict-Affected and High-Risk Areas the supply chain touches. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes (e.g. ['CD','CO','MM']). Empty array means no CAHRAS exposure declared.

mitigation_measures.description: Free-text description of mitigation measures put in place (Art. 50). E.g. 'On-site audits, supplier training, traceability records'.

grievance_mechanism_url.description: URL where affected stakeholders can lodge complaints.

issued_date.description: Date the due-diligence verification was issued (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

expires_date.description: Optional expiry date of the verification.

report_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the audit PDF for tamper-evidence.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the verification, exceptions or limitations.
